description: Jamie Lee incurs USD 180 for emergency dental treatment on October 20, 2026, before completion of the 90-day dental waiting period under P1_HEALTH. The claim is submitted on October 22, 2026.

expected_result.reason: The emergency dental benefit is subject to a 90-day waiting period. The incident occurs before the waiting period has been completed.
expected_result.scope_note: Only the emergency dental benefit is ineligible under this scenario. Other P1 benefits are not automatically denied.
